$comment: Recipe consumed by ~/.claude/skills/cut-release/SKILL.md. Vestige's project() block spans multiple lines, so version_pattern targets the indented VERSION line. The dated CHANGELOG section is written by hand before the release; an x.y.0 release also owes the audit in .claude/rules/release-audit.md.
post_check: v=$(sed -nE 's/^ +VERSION ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$/\1/p' CMakeLists.txt | head -n1); test -n "$v" && test "$v" = "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < VERSION)" && grep -qE "^## \[$v\] - [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$" CHANGELOG.md
